title.narrative: Reconstruction of Health Units in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

description.narrative: In April and May 2024, the Brazilian state of Rio Grande do Sul experienced severe flooding and landslides due to intense rainfall. This resulted in the largest socio-environmental catastrophe in the state's history, causing widespread damage to essential infrastructure, including public and private facilities, and basic services. In response to this disaster, the Brazilian federal government mobilized resources for the recovery of the state, particularly for the reconstruction of public and private infrastructure and the reestablishment of basic services, and the Ministry of Health requested assistance from UNOPS to provide technical assistance and support in the construction of new health facilities in the affected areas.
